tasks.short: Maintain office hours for student advice.

steps.what: Check and update actual office-hour availability when the established schedule changes
Save the checked final office-hour availability entry
Maintain regularly scheduled office hours to advise and assist students

tasks.design: Keep student advice with the teacher and the occasional availability update in the existing {CALENDAR}. Calendar entry and save are split out, but no actual repeated work has been established that a new tool removes.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task depends on actual student assistance, with very little occasional calendar work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar functionality already handles availability.
tasks.still_hard: Student concerns and ethical or academic questions require personal advice.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher understands the student's actual reasoning and circumstances.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native calendars support office-hour availability, while the actual advice remains interpersonal work.

assumptions: Schedule maintenance is occasional, counted once per actual change rather than per office-hour session. Shares are provisional, not measured baselines; if no calendar edit occurs, reweight advice to 100.

The calendar write and save are explicitly separated and retained. No required student note, report or digital send is specified by this task; actual additional documentation must be decomposed before estimating it.
Existing native scheduling earns zero new saving. The save uses the existing final entry check and adds no self-approval work. No new software means no incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Is office-hour availability entered into more than one actual system?
research_questions: Confirm actual duplicate scheduling before proposing any change.

incremental.description: No new scheduling software or upkeep.

approvals.approved_version: s1 checked final availability entry and exact calendar destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All advice and occasional native schedule work remain retained; no new saving or upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in recruitment, registration and placement.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual programme, student and registration or placement information
outputs: checked relevant recruitment, registration and placement context

steps.what: Participate in actual student recruitment conversations and activities
inputs: checked relevant recruitment, registration and placement context

steps.what: Prepare actual authorised registration entries in the student information system {OTHER}
inputs: checked relevant recruitment, registration and placement context
actual authorised course and registration choices

steps.what: Check final actual registration entry against student identity, request and authorised choices
inputs: actual authorised course and registration choices

steps.what: Commit the checked final actual registration entry
Participate in actual placement discussions with students and placement personnel
inputs: checked relevant recruitment, registration and placement context
outputs: actual placement discussion and agreed next steps

steps.what: Record and check actual placement discussion and agreed next steps
inputs: actual placement discussion and agreed next steps
outputs: checked final actual placement participation record

steps.what: Save the checked final actual placement participation record
inputs: checked final actual placement participation record

tasks.design: Configure native programme/student source views in {CRM}, {DOCS} and the student information system {OTHER}, with existing registration-field reuse. The teacher retains recruitment and placement conversations, checks final registration and captures actual participation outcomes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation can involve repeated source navigation and registration reference entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native context views and exact existing student-field reuse can reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Student needs, programme fit and placement suitability require personal discussion and actual authority.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises circumstances not captured in a registration field.
tasks.altitude: Less navigation and registration entry; student interactions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native student/programme views and registration-field reuse can reduce repeated entry; they do not select students or decide placement suitability.

assumptions: Actual programme owner supplies current information, student/registration owner supplies existing student identity and request, and placement office supplies actual opportunities. Teacher verifies context and obtains actual choices within retained s1/s3; missing fields stay manual.

Recruitment, registration and placement are a provisional task mix, not a mandatory pipeline for each student or a measured baseline. Registration entry applies only where this teacher actually performs it within existing authority; otherwise no entry saving is claimed.
Actual placement note capture is split and fully retained, with no free conversation transcript. No placement outcome is inferred from a plan. Omit any absent record and reweight.

Native functions first; existing configuration earns zero saving. Routine commits each retain one percent and use existing final checks without extra self-approval work. Any external placement offer/send is a separate gated action with no saving claimed.
unknowns: Which registration fields are actually entered by the teacher?
research_questions: Can native views and field reuse reduce actual participation administration without changing student decisions?

incremental.description: Maintain actual student/programme views and registration mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual registration entry and exact student/course destination; edits require recheck
s7 checked final actual placement participation record and exact student destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.50 navigation + 20*0.50 registration entry = 15; minus 1 upkeep = 14. Half eligible gives 7.5 minus 1 = 6.5. Recruitment, placement discussion, actual outcome notes and commits stay retained.

steps.what: Retrieve actual specialised materials and existing bibliographic metadata
inputs: actual library catalogue and publication records

steps.what: Select actual specialised materials appropriate for outside reading assignments
inputs: actual course goals and student needs
outputs: actual selected readings with verified citation fields

steps.what: Compile bibliographies of selected specialised materials using native reference management {OTHER}
inputs: actual selected readings with verified citation fields

steps.what: Check final bibliography entries, citation accuracy and actual reading availability
inputs: actual selected readings with verified citation fields

steps.what: Save the checked final outside-reading bibliography

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue/source links and citation export in the reference manager {OTHER}, saving the actual bibliography in {DOCS}. The teacher selects and verifies readings, checks the final formatted list and saves it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bibliographies can repeat source navigation and citation transcription/formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference metadata and citation-style export can remove that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Relevance, scholarly quality and appropriate reading load require teacher judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher selects materials that develop the intended social work understanding.
tasks.altitude: Less citation assembly; reading selection stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reference managers can export citations from verified source metadata; they do not choose appropriate scholarly readings or invent missing sources.

assumptions: Actual catalogue/publication owner supplies author, title, year, publication, pages and persistent identifier when present. Teacher verifies source identity in s1/s2 and manually captures missing metadata within retained work; no invented citation is allowed.
S3 removes actual repeated citation entry and formatting only. Scholarly reading/selection and full final accuracy/availability check remain retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native reference export first; existing citation automation earns zero saving. Routine save is one percent and uses the existing final check. Any student-facing publication is a separate actual gated action with no saving claimed.
unknowns: How much citation formatting is currently manual?
research_questions: Does native export reduce assembly after complete source identity and accuracy checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual reference-field mapping and citation-style settings.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final bibliography and exact course document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 navigation + 25 citation assembly = 35; minus 1 upkeep = 34. Half eligible gives 17.5 minus 1 = 16.5. Selection, metadata verification, final check and save stay retained.

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue/source links and selected-line order reuse in {PROCUREMENT}, with teaching specifications in {DOCS}. The teacher chooses materials, checks the final order, sends it within actual authority and verifies actual receipt or access before recording it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Obtaining materials can repeat catalogue navigation and selected-item entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue links and order templates can reduce repeated preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching suitability, budget choices and actual delivery/access require human checks.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises whether the received edition or equipment actually supports the course.
tasks.altitude: Less ordering preparation; selection and receipt remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native catalogue links and selected-line purchase functions can reduce duplicate ordering entry; an order is not evidence of actual receipt or usable access.

assumptions: Actual supplier/catalogue owner supplies item identifier, edition/specification, price and availability. Teacher verifies sources in s1, chooses actual quantities and supplier in s2 and captures unsupported delivery/billing fields in retained s3.

Ordering applies only where the teacher actually performs it within existing authority; a purchaser-owned action is separate with no avoided labour claimed. Materials can be purchased, borrowed or provided digitally; shares are a provisional actual task mix, not mandatory ordering per material or a measured baseline.
Actual delivered quantity, condition or usable access is obtained in s6 and captured in retained s7. No planned receipt, free scanning or automatic access verification is assumed.

Native functions first; already configured ordering earns zero saving. Routine send and receipt commit each retain one percent and use existing final checks. Omit any absent receipt record and reweight rather than invent one.
unknowns: Which order fields are actually copied by the teacher?
Who places orders and records receipt?
research_questions: Can native selected-line reuse reduce preparation after full selection and authority checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual catalogue links and order field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final materials order, exact items, quantities, prices, supplier and delivery destination; edits void approval
s7 checked final actual receipt entry and exact order destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 source navigation + 20*0.50 order entry = 20; minus 1 upkeep = 19. Half eligible gives 10 minus 1 = 9. Selection, final check, send, actual receipt and receipt entry/commit stay retained.
